about_the_game:
This update for Dragon Fist makes every match a blood sport!

New Arena: Hall of Heroes

A dingy underground fight club inspired by the 1988 martial arts film Bloodsport. Masters of many different styles will clash here, but only one can rise up as the champion.

3 New Fighters:

Three new fighters based on kung fu legends are here to challenge you in the Hall of Heroes!

  • Sakda Suwan - Inspired by Ting from Ong-Bak (2003). With his Special Move, Rising Knee, he can launch forward with a devastating flying strike.

  • Jim Wilson - Inspired by Williams from Enter the Dragon (1973). He can unleash a speedy assault with his Special Move, Dynamic Kicks.

  • Frank Grayson - Inspired by Mike from Ip Man 3 (2015). His Special Move, Pocket Sand, throws sand into opponent's eyes, blinding them temporarily.

content_descriptors.notes: Dragon Fist VR is a martial arts fighting game featuring hand-to-hand combat between human characters. Battles are realistic in style but do not contain blood, gore, or graphic injury detail. Defeated fighters are shown falling unconscious rather than dying. The game does not depict sexual content, sexual assault, drug or alcohol use, or self-harm.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1, Windows 8.1 or later, Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590/AMD FX 8350 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR. Standing or Room Scale
